items.title: Energy Transition Today - LevelTen Energy Ventures Into Asia-Pacific Clean Energy Market
items.summary: LevelTen Energy has announced its expansion into the Asia-Pacific region, marking a significant development in the global energy transition. This move extends LevelTen's clean energy marketplace, which supports corporate buyers in North America and Europe, into a region that consumes half of the world's electricity.
